# Plan work as issues

The rules are in the yardhand section of AGENTS.md (or CLAUDE.md). Read it first. When this repo has the CLI (`npx yardhand`, or `pnpm dlx yardhand` / `bunx yardhand`), use it for new IDs, status moves and front matter. Without it, follow the rules in that section exactly. That section also says what each status means; never move an issue into or out of a status that has no description unless asked.

1. Run `npx yardhand list` and check the work is not already filed.
2. Choose the level. A goal or feature is level 1 (`017`). A piece of it is level 2 (`017.01`). Something one model session can build is level 3 (`017.01.01`). Maintenance and bugs with no clear home go under `000`.
3. Create each issue with `npx yardhand new <slug> --parent <id>`. Slugs start with a verb (`add-login-form`). For a bug, add `--kind bug` and describe the symptom (`login-redirect-loop`). Never pick an ID yourself.
4. In each new ISSUE.md, write the H1 title and the Description (what and why). Add acceptance criteria if they are already clear.
5. Leave new issues where `new` puts them. Getting them ready is the yardhand-refine skill's job.
6. Run `npx yardhand validate` and fix any errors. Reply with the IDs you created.

Do not write code.
